{"code": "import logging
import os
import sys

import requests

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    stream=sys.stdout,
    format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s",
)
log = logging.getLogger("task_1010")


def get_base_url():
    base = os.environ.get("GITLAB_DOMAIN", "").strip()
    if not base:
        from config.servers import SERVER_URLS
        base = SERVER_URLS["gitlab"]
    return base.rstrip("/")


def get_token(base_url):
    token = os.environ.get("GITLAB_TOKEN", "").strip()
    if not token:
        from config.init_tokens.refresh_gitlab_token import refresh_token
        token = refresh_token(base_url=base_url)
    return token


def main():
    base_url = get_base_url()
    token = get_token(base_url)

    project_id = "byteblaze/dotfiles"
    issue_iid = 71
    comment_body = "We are working on it."

    headers = {"PRIVATE-TOKEN": token}

    encoded_project = requests.utils.quote(project_id, safe="")
    url = f"{base_url}/api/v4/projects/{encoded_project}/issues/{issue_iid}/discussions"
    log.info("POST discussion comment on issue iid=%d", issue_iid)

    try:
        resp = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json={"body": comment_body})
    except requests.RequestException as exc:
        log.error("Request failed: %s", exc)
        sys.exit(1)

    if resp.status_code == 404:
        log.error("Resource not found (404): %s - %.500s", url, resp.text)
        sys.exit(1)
    elif resp.status_code in (401, 403):
        log.error("Auth error (%s): %.500s", resp.status_code, resp.text)
        sys.exit(1)
    elif resp.status_code == 400:
        log.error("Bad request (400) to %s: %.500s", url, resp.text)
        sys.exit(1)
    elif resp.status_code not in (200, 201):
        log.error("Unexpected status %s from %s: %.500s", resp.status_code, url, resp.text)
        sys.exit(1)

    try:
        data = resp.json()
    except Exception as exc:
        log.error("Failed to parse response JSON: %s", exc)
        sys.exit(1)

    if "id" not in data:
        log.error("Response missing expected fields. Keys present: %s", list(data.keys()))
        sys.exit(1)

    log.info("Comment posted successfully with status %s", resp.status_code)

    print("===== FINAL ANSWER =====")
    print("Successfully posted comment on issue #71 in byteblaze/dotfiles: We are working on it.")
    print("===== END FINAL ANSWER =====")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"}
